item.tib: khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las che mchog rta mgrin gtum chen drag po'i sgrub gzhung chen mo
item.coloph: zhes 'bru'i rgyud bzhi las khro mchog 'dus pa 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud che mchog rta mgrin gtum chen drag po'i sgrub pa 'di nyid mdo khams smad kyi gnas mchog the chu'i brag dkar bya rgod gsang ba'i mdun zhol dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro skal pa bzang mo'i bka' rtags zhabs rjes kyi g.yon mdun nyi ma rang shar brag gi g.yas rgyab mkha' 'gro'i gsang lung gi che mchog rta mgrin gtso 'khor gyi tshul du bzhengs shing bka' rtags rta dbu 'dra ba'i mar zhabs zhes pa yongs grags su brag nor bu rdzong gi byang ngos sked gsang ska rags 'dra ba'i khong seng gi bar nas sa stag lo'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gcig gi tho rangs su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rang 'byung sgrol ma dang bstan srung lha btsan rgyal pos lung bstan te kho bo phyogs med kyi rnal 'byor ba gtsug phud rnam rgyal du 'bod pa mkha' 'gro'i lung gis gsang bdag ye shes mgon po zhes bya ba bdag gis dngos grub tu brnyed nas slar mda' chen dkar mo ri khrod du slebs tshe rig 'dzin dmu tsa dra (tra) he'i rnam rol skyang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan nam kun gsal mtshan can de dang rin chen mtshan can la sogs shog ser dkyus lha grogs dam pa rnams kyis bskyal tshe legs pa'i rten 'brel kyang phun sum tshogs par byung ba nas su mtho do zhing du sor gnyis yig 'phreng brda don bdun pa can la zhal bshus pa 'di yis gsang ba sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs bcur khyab cing rgyas te gdul bya rnams thar pa bde chen mchog gi go 'phang la sbyor ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig gu
